tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.class: Financial Literacy- Formal Education vs Experience
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: Today we'll discuss the importance of financial literacy for young adults. Clearly, understanding financial concepts can help young adults make informed decisions about their money. On the other hand, some people believe that financial education should be learned through experience. Which do you believe plays a larger role in financial literacy? Why?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I think formal financial education is crucial for young adults. Learning about budgeting, saving, and investing in a structured way can provide a strong foundation for making informed financial decisions.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: I believe that learning through experience is more impactful. Real-life financial decisions and managing money firsthand can teach valuable lessons that formal education might not cover.
